summary:
## HubSpot Toolkit

Arcade's HubSpot toolkit lets LLMs interact with HubSpot CRM — creating, retrieving, updating, and associating CRM records and engagement activities on behalf of authenticated users.

## Capabilities

- **Contact & Company management:** Create, search, list, and update contacts and companies, including industry-type validation.
- **Deal management:** Create and update deals across pipelines and stages; inspect pipelines and stages; update close dates; associate contacts, companies, and activities to deals.
- **Activity logging:** Create and update calls, emails, meetings, notes, communications (SMS, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, etc.), and tasks — each requiring at least one CRM association (contact, company, or deal).
- **Search & retrieval:** Keyword-based search across all object types (contacts, companies, deals, calls, emails, meetings, notes, tasks, communications); fetch any deal by ID with its full association graph.
- **User & portal context:** Look up all portal users/owners, retrieve a specific user by ID, and identify the current authenticated user and their portal (`WhoAmI` — typically the first call in an agent flow).
- **Toolkit guidance:** A built-in meta-tool (`ToolkitEnviromentGuidance`) surfaces best practices and contextual considerations for orchestrating HubSpot tools effectively.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses **OAuth 2.0** via the HubSpot provider. See the [Arcade HubSpot auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/hubspot) for setup details including required scopes.
